brief.headline: NVDA's 4.9x volume selloff dominates; AMD surges on AI compute rotation
tldr: NVDA fell 4.3% on 4.9x normal volume, bottom 4% of its past year.
AMD jumped 5.9% on 2.2x volume, top 11% of its past year.
Small caps (IWM) dropped 1.6%, bottom 8% of its past year.

NVDA lost $4.3B in flow, down 4.3% on 4.9x volume.
IWM shed $4.9B in flow, down 1.6% on near-normal volume.
